The CI process had set umask 077 for secret files; because Directus runs under a different UID, the restrictive generated-directory/file modes explain the missing module. This diagnosis is an inference from the runner script, build ordering, and container log. Gateway and gRPC became healthy before the runner shutdown cancelled full-ci.
